newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-DENMARK BEAT BOSNIA 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DENMARK BEAT BOSNIA 2-0 IN WORLD CUP QUALFIER.

text.p: Denmark beat Bosnia 2-0 (halftime 0-0) in their World Cup European zone group one qualifier on Sunday.

Denmark: 1-Peter Schmeichel, 2-Jacob Laursen, 3-Marc Rieper, 4-Jes Hoegh, 5-Jan Heintze(12-Michael Schjoenberg, 80), 6-Thomas Helveg, 7-Allan Nielsen 8-Claus Thomsen, 9-Jon Dahl Tomasson (13-Per Frandsen, 52), 10-Per Pedersen (18-Miklos Molnar, 66) 11-Brian Laudrup.

Bosnia: 1-Mirsad Dedic, 2-Nermin Sabic (17-Vedin Music, 71) 3-Bakeh Besehovc, 4-Muhamed Konjic (15-Edin Ramcic, 17) 5-Suad Katana, 6-Mirsad Hibic, 7-Vlatko Glavas, 8-Sejad Halilovic, 9-Meho Kodro (14-Edin Mujcin, 37) 10-Elvir Bolic, 11-Elvir Baljic.
